article.title: Psychobiological Effects of Music Therapy and Structured Musical Interventions on Biomarkers in Mental Disorders: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
article.abstract: To systematically synthesize evidence on the psychobiological effects of music therapy and structured musical interventions on biomarkers in individuals with mental disorders, within a psychoneuroimmunological framework.
